title: What fractions mean
subtitle: Explore the idea with a visual model.
learning_objective: Connect a fraction to equal parts of one whole.

sections.heading: Make sense of it
sections.body: A fraction names equal parts of one whole. The denominator tells how many equal parts make the whole; the numerator tells how many parts are selected.

sections.heading: Build a picture
sections.caption: Each row represents the same-sized whole.

sections.problem: A rectangle is split into 4 equal parts and 3 are shaded. Name the fraction.
steps: Check that all four parts are equal.
Count all parts for the denominator: 4.
Count shaded parts for the numerator: 3.
sections.reasoning: Each step keeps the meaning of the whole and its equal parts clear.

sections.heading: Watch for this
sections.body: Unequal pieces do not represent equal fractional parts.

sections.heading: Your turn
sections.prompt: A shape has 5 equal parts and 2 are shaded. What fraction is shaded?
sections.hint: Use the visual and the worked steps above before choosing.
